title: Aspire: Academically Sound Preparation for Involved Research Education
description: This course is designed to introduce students to the College of Arts and Sciences, with a focus on academic success strategies that can be used throughout their college careers. Through guest lectures, discussions, and in-class exercises, A&S 141 will enable students to actively develop and maintain skill sets and information relevant to their major and planned career path while also emphasizing the interdisciplinary nature of college learning.
